name: Bank of America® Premium Rewards® credit card

localized_names.en: Bank of America® Premium Rewards® credit card

apr.notes: Variable APR for purchases and balance transfers; see current Bank of America offer for exact terms.

rewards.currency_label: Bank of America Premium Rewards points

base_rate.description: 1.5 points per $1 spent on all other purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem for cash back as a deposit into eligible Bank of America checking or savings accounts, credit to eligible Merrill accounts including 529 accounts, statement credit, gift cards, or purchases at BofA Travel.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 60,000 online bonus points after making at least $4,000 in purchases in the first 90 days of account opening.

benefits.title: Airline Incidental Statement Credits
benefits.description: Up to $100 annually in statement credits for qualifying airline incidental purchases such as seat upgrades, baggage fees, in-flight services, and airline lounge fees.

benefits.title: TSA PreCheck or Global Entry statement credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 in Airport Security Statement Credits for TSA PreCheck or Global Entry application fees every four years.

benefits.title: Travel insurance protections
benefits.description: Travel protections to assist with trip delays, cancellations and interruptions, baggage delays, lost luggage, and emergency evacuation and transportation.

benefits.title: Purchase protections
benefits.description: Purchase Security, Warranty Manager Service, and Return Protection for eligible purchases.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Reimbursement for damage due to collision or theft on eligible rentals; coverage is supplemental to and in excess of other insurance when the rental agency's collision/loss damage waiver is declined.

benefits.title: Visa Signature Luxury Hotel Collection
benefits.description: Access to the Visa Signature Luxury Hotel Collection when booking with the Premium Rewards card.

benefits.title: Visa Signature concierge service
benefits.description: Access to concierges who can help with travel planning, restaurant recommendations, and event reservations.

other: Up to $100 annual Airline Incidental Statement Credits

notes: Preferred Rewards relationship bonuses can increase earn rates for eligible clients; base earn rates are shown here.
